cards.front: Recall a key point about Redox and Electrochemistry
cards.back: Oxidation = loss of e⁻ (OIL RIG); Oxidation state rules: element=0, Group 1=+1, O=-2 (exc peroxides), H=+1 (exc hydrides)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Redox and Electrochemistry
cards.back: Half-equations: balance atoms (O with H₂O, H with H⁺), then charge with e⁻

cards.front: Recall a key point about Redox and Electrochemistry
cards.back: Cell: anode (oxidation) || cathode (reduction); E deg _cell = E deg _red(cathode) - E deg _red(anode)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Redox and Electrochemistry
cards.back: Feasible if E deg _cell > 0; Equilibrium: E deg _cell = 0.059/n log K at 298K

cards.front: Recall a key point about Redox and Electrochemistry
cards.back: Nernst: E = E deg - 0.059/n log Q; concentration cells generate voltage from conc difference

cards.front: Recall a key point about Redox and Electrochemistry
cards.back: Fuel cell: H₂ + ½O₂ -> H₂O; H₂ oxidised at anode, O₂ reduced at cathode; high efficiency

cards.front: Recall a key point about Redox and Electrochemistry
cards.back: Rechargeable: Li-ion (LiCoO₂/Li), NiMH, lead-acid; reversible redox
